summary: Brera Holdings PLC, operating as Solmate Infrastructure (NASDAQ: SLMT), filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, with a press release announcing the acquisition of an additional 1,001 SOL, bringing total holdings to approximately 1.26 million SOL. The CEO stated the company intends to continue accumulating SOL as a strategic digital asset treasury play, partly in response to Solana validator proposals that could reduce issuance and increase burning. No price per share, premium, or deal value was disclosed. No board recommendation or advisors were named. This is an ordinary operational treasury purchase, not a special situation; the filing simply reports routine business activity and does not trigger any M&A, restructuring, or capital markets category.
